title_en: A Birthday Gift from Far Away
source_file: 远方寄来的生日礼物（2-5 岁）-.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh:
提姆和莎兰是一对双胞胎小老鼠。
这一天，他们站在窗前，向外望了好一会儿了。
“啊，邮递员叔叔来了！还带了个大大的包裹！”
“一定是我们的生日礼物，因为今天是我们的生日呀！”
“太好了！”
两人急忙跑下楼。
page_text_en:
Tim and Sarah are twin little mice.
One day, they stood by the window, looking outside for a while.
"Ah, the mailman is here! And he's brought a big package!"
"It must be our birthday gift, because today is our birthday!"
"Great!"
The two hurried downstairs.
summary_zh: 双胞胎小老鼠提姆和莎兰在窗前看到邮递员送来大包裹，兴奋地认为是生日礼物，便急忙跑下楼去迎接。

title_en: A Birthday Gift from Far Away

page_text_ocr_zh:
“您好，夫人！
天儿真是越来越凉了！
邮递员叔叔说，
‘我给提姆和莎兰送包裹来了。’
听了邮递员叔叔的话，
提姆和莎兰激动地跳了起来。
‘啊，真是我们的生日礼物！’
‘妈妈，可以打开吗？’
‘可以啊！’
page_text_en:
"Hello, madam!
It's getting colder and colder!
The postman said,
'I've brought a package for Tim and Sarah.'
Hearing the postman's words,
Tim and Sarah jumped up excitedly.
'Oh, it's really our birthday gift!'
'Mom, can we open it?'
'Of course!'
summary_zh: 邮递员叔叔送来一个包裹，提姆和莎兰兴奋地认为是生日礼物，迫不及待地请求妈妈打开。

title_en: A Birthday Gift from Far Away
source_file: 远方寄来的生日礼物（2-5 岁）-.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh:
两人打开包裹箱，里面是两个扎着丝带的盒子，还有一封信。
“啊，是你们的爷爷奶奶寄来的。信上说：‘提姆、莎兰，祝你们生日快乐！这是送给你们的生日礼物。到了春天，希望你们能来核桃村玩。’你们高兴吧！
“啊，太好了！这个扎着蓝丝带的肯定是给我的。”
“那扎着红丝带的就是给我的。”
page_text_en:
The two opened the package box, which contained two boxes tied with ribbons and a letter.
"Ah, it's from your grandparents. The letter says: 'Tim, Sarah, happy birthday! This is a birthday gift for you. In spring, we hope you can come to Walnut Village to play.' Are you happy?"
"Ah, great! The one with the blue ribbon must be for me."
"Then the one with the red ribbon is for me."
summary_zh: 提姆和莎兰与妈妈一起打开爷爷奶奶寄来的生日礼物包裹，里面有两个扎着丝带的盒子和一封信，孩子们兴奋地认领各自的礼物。

title_en: A Birthday Gift from Far Away
source_file: 远方寄来的生日礼物（2-5 岁）-.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh:
扎着红丝带的盒子里装着两条围巾、
两副手套和两顶帽子。
它们软软的，看上去很暖和。
帽子和围巾上还有毛茸茸的小球。

扎着蓝丝带的盒子里，
装着好多好多木头做的小玩具。
“哇，太棒了！这些都是我的！”，
“才不是呢，应该一人一半儿！”
page_text_en:
In the box tied with a red ribbon, there were two scarves, 
two pairs of gloves, and two hats.
They were soft and looked very warm.
The hats and scarves had fluffy little balls on them.

In the box tied with a blue ribbon, 
there were lots and lots of wooden toys.
"Wow, great! These are all mine!"
"No way, it should be half for each of us!"
summary_zh: 双胞胎小老鼠提姆和莎兰打开爷爷奶奶寄来的生日礼物，发现红丝带盒子里是围巾、手套和帽子，蓝丝带盒子里是木头玩具，两人对玩具的分配产生争执。

“我回来了！”
提姆和莎兰正玩得起劲儿，
连爸爸回来了都没发现。
“呵呵，你们俩玩得可真开心！”
page_text_en:
"I'm back!"
Tim and Sarah were playing so hard,
they didn't even notice Dad had come home.
"Hehe, you two are having such a good time!"
summary_zh: 爸爸回家时，提姆和莎兰正专注地玩着木头玩具，完全没有注意到爸爸的到来，爸爸看到他们玩得开心，感到欣慰。

“喂，莎兰，那个小羊让我玩一会儿。”
“不给，这是我喜欢的！”

“就玩一会儿还不行吗？”
“我说不行就不行！”

两人争抢起来，
一下把小羊弄坏了。
page_text_en:
"Hey, Sarah, let me play with that little sheep for a moment."
"No way, I like it!"

"Can't I just play with it for a little while?"
"I said no, so no!"

The two started fighting over it,
and accidentally broke the little sheep.
summary_zh: 双胞胎小老鼠提姆和莎兰因争夺木头玩具小羊而发生争执，两人争抢中不小心把小羊弄坏了。

page_text_ocr_zh:
“哇，好棒的蛋糕呀！”
提姆和莎兰的眼睛闪闪发亮。
“这是妈妈送给你们的生日礼物！”妈妈微笑着说。
提姆等不及了，伸手就去拿蛋糕。
“吃蛋糕之前，先把帽子和围巾放回去。”
“不能戴着帽子吃蛋糕吗？我真的很喜欢这顶帽子呀！”莎兰不高兴地说。
“莎兰，你戴的那顶帽子呀，是用你小时候穿的毛衣改的。”
“啊，真的呀！”
“你们的奶奶经常把旧衣服改成漂亮的床罩、坐垫什么的。
有时还一边织织补补，一边做好吃的蛋糕和奶油汤呢！”
“哇，奶奶好像有魔法似的！”
page_text_en:
"Wow, what a wonderful cake!"
Tim and Sarah's eyes sparkled.
"This is Mommy's birthday gift for you two!" Mom said with a smile.
Tim couldn't wait and reached for the cake.
"Before eating the cake, put your hat and scarf away first."
"Can't I eat cake with my hat on? I really love this hat!" Sarah said unhappily.
"Sarah, the hat you're wearing was made from the sweater you wore when you were little."
"Oh, really!"
"Your grandma often turns old clothes into beautiful bed covers and cushions.
Sometimes she knits and mends while making delicious cakes and cream soup!"
"Wow, Grandma is like a magician!"
summary_zh: 妈妈为双胞胎小老鼠提姆和莎兰准备了生日蛋糕作为礼物，孩子们兴奋不已。莎兰舍不得摘下奶奶用旧毛衣改的帽子，妈妈解释了帽子的来历，孩子们对奶奶的巧手感到惊叹。

page_text_ocr_zh:
爸爸送给提姆和莎兰的生日礼物，
是从街上买的一大块奶酪。
生日晚餐可真丰盛，好吃极了，
一家人都吃得饱饱的。
吃过晚餐，爸爸开始修理玩具小羊。

“这个是爷爷做的吗？”提姆问。
“是啊！爷爷是村里最有名的木匠，
这只小羊是他用碎木块儿做的。”
“爷爷真了不起！”提姆和莎兰异口同声地说。
“爸爸小时候，
爷爷也为爸爸做过好多玩具呢！”
爸爸沉浸在美好的回忆中。
page_text_en:
Dad's birthday gift for Tim and Sarah was a big block of cheese bought from the street.
Dinner was so delicious and abundant, everyone ate until they were full.
After dinner, Dad began repairing the toy lamb.

"Did Grandpa make this?" Tim asked.
"Yes! Grandpa was the most famous carpenter in the village,
and he made this lamb from scraps of wood."
"Grandpa is amazing!" Tim and Sarah said in unison.
"When Dad was little,
Grandpa made lots of toys for him too!"
Dad was lost in happy memories.
summary_zh: 爸爸为双胞胎小老鼠提姆和莎兰修理玩具小羊，孩子们得知小羊是爷爷用碎木块做的，对爷爷的手艺赞叹不已，爸爸也沉浸在对童年时光的美好回忆中。

“我们有一个好主意。”提姆和莎兰转动着大眼睛说，
“这个好主意就是给爷爷奶奶写封信。”
“真是个不错的想法！”
两人坐到爸爸的书桌前，开始写信。
“啊，糟糕！”
莎兰把墨水滴到了纸上。
接着，更糟糕的事情发生了——提姆把墨水瓶碰倒了。
“啊，怎么办呀……”
page_text_en:
"We have a great idea," Tim and Sarah said, turning their big eyes.
"This great idea is to write a letter to Grandpa and Grandma."
"That's a wonderful idea!"
They sat at Dad's desk and began writing.
"Oh, no!"
Sarah dripped ink onto the paper.
Then, something even worse happened—Tim knocked over the ink bottle.
"Oh, what should we do...?"
summary_zh: 双胞胎小老鼠提姆和莎兰决定给爷爷奶奶写信，但在写信过程中，莎兰滴了墨水，提姆又碰倒了墨水瓶，两人惊慌失措。

妈妈看到两个人满脸都是墨水，大吃一惊。
“哎呀，这两个孩子是谁呀？”
“妈妈，我们是提姆和莎兰呀！”
“我们写好信了。”
莎兰得意洋洋地说。

“妈妈，你马上把这封信寄给爷爷奶奶吧。”
“一定要寄呀！”
“好的，好的，我一定寄。

page_text_en:
"It's time for bed!"
Mom saw the two children covered in ink and was greatly surprised.
"Oh my, who are these two children?"
"Mom, we're Tim and Sarah!"
"We've finished writing the letter."
Sarah said proudly.

"Mom, please send this letter to Grandpa and Grandma right away."
"Of course, I will!"
"Okay, okay, I promise I'll send it.
You can sleep peacefully now."
summary_zh: 双胞胎小老鼠提姆和莎兰写完信后满脸墨水，妈妈认出他们并答应将信寄给爷爷奶奶，孩子们安心入睡。

page_text_ocr_zh:
日本著名绘本作家芭蕉绿创作的双胞胎小老鼠提姆与莎兰，是无数孩子童年的挚爱。自1989年第一本“提姆与莎兰”出版以来，几乎每一年“提姆与莎兰”的推出，都会成为孩子们欢呼雀跃的盛事。这套绘本还被日本全国图书管理学会、日本图书馆协会指定为必选图书，成为生活教育绘本的典范之作。日本销量累计超过130万册。
故事中的主角虽然是小老鼠，讲述的却都是普通孩子的日常生活，从每天的玩耍、家庭的亲情，到与邻里的交往、结识新伙伴，内容特别贴近孩子的生活，对孩子的言行、神态描摹得惟妙惟肖，总能引起共鸣。一个个关于成长的小故事温馨舒缓、饱含深情，悄悄地在孩子们心中将美好渲染。柔和、明快的色彩，精致、传神的细节，富有音乐感的画面布局，让每本书都成为浑然天成的经典之作。
数十年来，无数爸爸妈妈把“提姆与莎兰”送给孩子当礼物，因为不管时空如何变幻，书中所表达出的温暖与美好，让每个年代的孩子都能感受到亘古不变的浓浓爱意。
这一集中，提姆和莎兰要过生日了，远方的爷爷、奶奶寄来的礼物可真棒！漂亮的围巾、好玩的玩具。可是提姆和莎兰竟为了抢玩具争吵起来。在爸爸、妈妈的悉心开导下，他们学会了分享，还懂得了要回报亲人的关爱。
page_text_en:
The twin mice Tim and Sarah, created by renowned Japanese picture book author Baojiao Lv, are beloved by countless children. Since the first "Tim and Sarah" was published in 1989, almost every new release has become a joyful event for children. This series has been designated as a required selection by the Japan National Library Association and the Japan Library Association, becoming a model for life-education picture books. Sales in Japan have exceeded 1.3 million copies.
Although the main characters are little mice, the stories depict the daily lives of ordinary children—from playing every day, family affection, to interacting with neighbors and making new friends. The content is especially close to children's lives, with vivid descriptions of their words and expressions, always resonating with readers. Each small story about growth is warm, gentle, and full of emotion, quietly painting beauty in children's hearts. The soft, bright colors, exquisite and expressive details, and musically harmonious composition make each book a naturally perfect classic.
For decades, countless parents have given "Tim and Sarah" as gifts to their children, because regardless of how time and space change, the warmth and beauty expressed in the books allow children of every generation to feel timeless, deep affection.
In this volume, Tim and Sarah are celebrating their birthday. The gifts from their grandparents far away are wonderful—beautiful scarves and fun toys. But Tim and Sarah end up arguing over the toys. With the careful guidance of their parents, they learn to share and also understand the importance of returning love to their family.
summary_zh: 本页为绘本《提姆与莎兰》的介绍文字，说明了该系列的创作背景、受欢迎程度及教育意义，并简述了本册故事内容：双胞胎小老鼠提姆和莎兰收到爷爷奶奶寄来的生日礼物后因争抢玩具而争吵，在父母引导下学会分享与感恩。页面下方配有一幅雪景木屋插图，屋前有雪人和小牛车。
